attempts.text: MATCH (c:Issue)-[:HAS_PARENT]->(p:Issue), (c)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(cp:Project), (p)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pp:Project), (c)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(a:Person) WHERE cp.projectKey IN ['CLOUD','CLOV'] AND pp.projectKey IN ['CLOUD','CLOV'] AND a.personKey <> '' WITH p, collect(DISTINCT a.personKey) AS ppl WHERE size(ppl)>=2 RETURN p.issueKey AS id, ppl
